title: Orbs seen during sky observing at Bledsoe home
summary: Bob McGwier tells of Orbs seen during sky observing at Bledsoe home, about undated at Chris Bledsoe's home, North Carolina, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: right above the trees about 3 or 400 m away this thing flashed into existence it was a massive orb very bright

plain: Bob McGwier, described on Jesse Michels's podcast as a former CIA contractor, says he watched the sky at the North Carolina home of Chris Bledsoe, a man known for reports of glowing balls of light called orbs, with Ryan Bledsoe and Richard Dolan. He says a massive, very bright orb "flashed into existence" above the trees about 300 or 400 metres away, which would back up Bledsoe's claims with a second witness.
